# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **eCat captures 87.8% of total business value** — at $10.9M GMV across 3,320 orders, the platform is the primary transaction system for the trailing 12 months. [→ §commerce]
2. **iPad orders carry a 24% AOV premium over eCat Online** — $3,562 vs $2,871 average order value; rep-driven orders consistently produce higher-value transactions in the trailing 12 months. [→ §commerce]
3. **Quote workflow at only 1.1% of orders but 2.2× the confirmed-order AOV** — at $7,088 per quote vs $3,235 per confirmed order, this is an under-utilized high-value path. [→ §commerce]
4. **Customer concentration is healthy** — top 5 buyers represent just 13.2% of eCat GMV over the trailing 12 months, well below the 25% concentration threshold. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **HIGH**: Expand quote workflow adoption — at $7,088 AOV (2.2× confirmed orders), even modest increases in quote usage could meaningfully lift blended AOV. [→ §commerce]
